critique: The white clipped core is gone, and the render now has a believable orange ember palette with dark gray smoke around the source. Motion from t1 to t4 is clearly visible. However, it still reads primarily as a compact, symmetric circular smoke ring ejecting a broad radial field of discrete sparks. It lacks the dense, irregular flame-led body and upward/rising smoky-fire structure expected of the Smokey Fire thumbnail; the flame remains a thin brown-orange ring around a dark center rather than a luminous fire mass.

suggestions.why: Change from the current explosive/radial emission behavior to directional emission so the sparks and fire stop forming a symmetric circular blast.
Reduce outward particle travel so the fire and smoke remain a dense readable source rather than becoming a large sparse spark halo by t4.
Introduce upward buoyancy so the smoky fire develops a rising, asymmetric flame/smoke silhouette instead of remaining centered as a circular ring.
Increase sprite scale to turn the thin central orange ring into a fuller flame-and-smoke body.
